subject: Exploratory: Datadog + Grafana joint partner pathway for observability integrations
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@datadoghq.com>, Tom Evans <tevans@grafana.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exploratory: Datadog + Grafana joint partner pathway for observability integrations

Hi Emily and Tom,

Thanks again for taking time to chat last week — appreciated the candid talk about how your customers are standardizing on OTLP and looking for turnkey ingestion and dashboards.

We'd like to explore a light-weight joint pathway where Redwood provides validated model-serving telemetry (OTLP + token-level tracing) and both Datadog and Grafana get an opinionated integration that makes adoption easier for platform teams (installer, reference dashboards, common sampling profiles). High-level asks:

- Confirm technical owners for a short discovery POC (2–3 weeks).
- Align on a go/no-go for a co-marketed technical brief and one customer POC.
- Discuss what lead-sharing / co-sell signals each side needs (deal size thresholds, account overlap).

I've attached a one-pager that sketches the proposal and a simple Alliance MAP (roles, milestones, success criteria). Would love to run a 30-min discovery next week to agree scope. Proposed slots: Tue 10/6 10am PT or Wed 10/7 2pm PT.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (Observability)
Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2026-10-03-datadog-grafana-brief.pdf, RDWD-Alliance-MAP.xlsx

Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exploratory: Datadog + Grafana joint partner pathway for observability integrations

Marissa — thanks, this looks interesting.

Quick notes from the Datadog side:
- Technical owner: Emily Wu (me) + Erik Santos (integrations). We can scope a short POC to validate event/trace mapping and a dashboard template.
- We prefer a 2-week POC where Redwood sends sample telemetry (KV + token-level traces) into our OTLP ingest and we validate a pre-built dashboard.
- On co-sell: Datadog can include co-sell credit for joint trials over $40k ARR; we use HubSpot signal "co-sell:true" and a level-2 partnership intake.

Tue 10/6 10am PT works for me. Sending calendar invite.

—Emily
Emily Wu
Partner Solutions Engineer, Datadog

Marissa / Emily — good to meet yesterday. A couple follow-ups from the Grafana side:

- We can provide a managed dashboard package and a Grafana Agent plugin for Redwood's OTLP metadata fields; engineering estimate ~3 weeks to produce a beta.
- For the commercial side: Grafana wants clarity on lead ownership for cross-sell and a simple customer-facing "bundle" description. We typically require a single point of contact at the partner (PM or GTM lead) for co-marketing sign-off.
- We're open to a shared case study if we do a joint POC with a customer in the mid-market vertical.

Tom Evans
Strategic Alliances, Grafana

Subject: RE: internal — Datadog + Grafana joint partner pathway (post-discovery)

Folks — summary/asks after the discovery:

1) Technical POC (2 weeks): Redwood to provide sample OTLP streams and token-level traces; Datadog + Grafana to validate ingest and dashboards. Engineering owners: Jonas (Redwood infra contact) + Erik (Datadog) + Tom (Grafana).
2) Commercial friction points: co-sell thresholds (Datadog threshold noted), lead routing rules (we need to capture in HubSpot), and who owns the single customer-facing bundle copy.
3) Marketing: ask for a short co-marketed brief and a joint webinar if the POC validates.

Action items for Redwood:
- Jonas: prep a trimmed sample telemetry dataset and run self-test to confirm schema by EOD Thu 10/8.
- Marissa: draft bundle copy and reach out to Tom about POC success criteria for dashboards.
- Grace: prepare a 1-page PR/brief template for co-marketing.

Vanessa
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Emily Wu <emily.wu@datadoghq.com>, Tom Evans <tevans@grafana.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>, Sara Patel <sara@observant.co>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and materials: Datadog + Grafana joint POC (RDWD propsal)

Emily, Tom — great momentum. Attached: brief + Alliance MAP; Jonas will drop the sample telemetry bundle in the shared Drive folder by EOD. Sara from Observant Consulting will be our neutral integrator for the POC if we need a third-party to run the customer-side install.

Initial success criteria (brief):
- End-to-end ingest of Redwood OTLP -> Datadog/Grafana within 48 hours of install
- Dashboard templates rendering key model metrics (latency, cost-per-token, error-rate)
- One joint case study or customer testimonial within 8 weeks of POC completion

Please confirm acceptance of the MAP and the timeline. If yes, I'll submit the partner intake to Datadog (co-sell:true) and schedule a short kickoff with all engineers.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (Observability)
Redwood Inference
